subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Board Diversity and Performance
description: Learn Board Diversity and Performance in one minute.

hook.text: A board of twelve white men over sixty all went to the same schools. They all think the same way.

buildup.text: Board diversity — in gender, race, age, and expertise — brings different perspectives to decision-making.

discovery.text: Studies show companies with diverse boards outperform peers on profitability and risk management.

twist.text: California mandated board diversity quotas. Courts struck them down. The push continues through investor pressure.

climax.text: Diversity isn't just fair — it's effective. Homogeneous boards miss risks that diverse ones catch.

punchline.text: Same backgrounds. Same blind spots. Diversity fixes that.

quiz.question: How does board diversity affect company performance?
options: Diverse boards tend to outperform on profitability and risk
